content.comment_body: When will you provide an update for [product_name] for macOS Catalina, which only supports 64-bit applications, as well as for Windows (32 and 64-bit)? Thank you. [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user is requesting information regarding an upcoming release of [product_name] that will work with macOS Catalina (which requires 64-bit applications), in addition to compatibility with both 32-bit and 64-bit Windows systems. The key issue is limited compatibility with the latest macOS version, leading to inconvenience for users dependent on Mac systems and highlighting the need for software updates to enable continued use.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for [company_name] to issue an updated version of [product_name] that works with macOS Catalina and continues supporting 32-bit and 64-bit Windows. They expect consistent cross-platform availability and reliable usability going forward.
